name: Translating the Journal

narrative.details:
Droffers and Son Salvage aren't smart enough to restore the magic in the necklace, but I am.  All I want to do is study the necklace so I can learn to make them myself.  To do that, I will need your necklace.  Let me borrow it, and in exchange for the time I get to study it I will translate the journal for you.  While you are searching for the gems, I should have enough time to learn what I need to.

It's a simple deal, and no one else will be the wiser.  Whatcha wanna do?
narrative.objectives: Let Jarkal borrow the necklace.  In exchange, he will translate the journal for you.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You know a good deal when you see one - I knew I could count on you.

It will be just a moment while I cast a spell to quickly translate the human tongue into a form you will understand. I am a troll of my word; ask anyone in the Horde about Jarkal Mossmeld. Now, let's get this started...
narrative.requestItemsText: You've thought about it, yes? You're a smart Champion if you take this deal - you and I will get what we both want, and Droffers and Son Salvage will think they're getting what they want.

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 41 to 44, 19,900 XP in all.

quests.name: Necklace Recovery
quests.objectiveText: Look for a valuable necklace within the Uldaman dig site and bring it back to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Necklace Recovery, Take 2
quests.objectiveText: Find a clue as to the gems' whereabouts in the depths of Uldaman.

quests.name: Translating the Journal
quests.objectiveText: Find someone who can translate the paladin's journal.

quests.name: Find the Gems and Power Source
quests.objectiveText: Recover all three gems and a power source for the necklace from Uldaman, and then bring them to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath.

quests.name: Deliver the Gems
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Necklace and Gem Salvage to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Necklace Recovery, Take 3
quests.objectiveText: Visit Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath to see if he was successful.
